chapter_title_en: The Green Sun Demon Flame Strikes
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 269: The Green Sun Demon Flame Sweeps the Battlefield
chapter_meta_description: The Blazing Flame Cultivators unleash the terrifying Green Sun Demon Flame, erasing Seven Sect cultivators. A desperate retreat and a secret tunnel offer a sliver of hope, but a sudden cave-in changes everything.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 269: A One-Sided Massacre Forces a Desperate Escape
og_description: A coordinated demon flame ritual wipes out the defenders. With the formation failing, a secret underground tunnel is their only hope—until the ground swallows them whole.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch. 269: Han Li barely escapes a demon flame apocalypse.
twitter_description: A powerful ritual attack forces the entire Seven Sect coalition to retreat into a hidden tunnel. The escape is short-lived when a cave-in buries everyone alive.

lore_anchors.definition: A devastating ritual flame technique that consumes a caster’s cultivation base to unleash unavoidable destruction.
A four-colored defensive barrier that can withstand significant force but is vulnerable to sustained elemental attacks.
Elite Devil Flame Sect members trained in synchronized ritual fire techniques; their power is immense but self-sacrificial.
